R1.description: An interrupt while the prune phase writes its started audit line stops the phase with interrupted and no engine call

R2.description: An interrupt while the prune phase writes the ok audit line after a successful apply stops the phase with interrupted, says the apply had succeeded, and records it in one audit line

R3.description: docs/retention.md says the interrupted result also covers an interrupt during the started or ok line, and a test pins the clause
